items.title: Scrap junk to produce Wood
items.detail: Craft Bulk Wood at a Tinker's Workbench or collect fallen trees

items.title: Complete the Event: "Fasnacht Day" while wearing a Fasnacht Mask
items.detail: Help Protectron marchers at Helvetia and equip a Fasnacht Mask before event ends

items.title: Drink Nuka-Cherry
items.detail: Obtain from a Nuka-Cola Collectron Station in a C.A.M.P.

items.title: Eat a Cake, Pie, or Candy
items.detail: Popcorn from a Popcorn Machine counts as candy

items.title: Kill a Super Mutant
items.detail: Fast travel to West Tek Research Center for reliable spawns

items.title: Kill an Enemy with any Pistol
items.detail: Craft a 10mm or Pipe Pistol and visit Wavy Willard's Water Park

items.title: Take a Camera Picture at the Rust Kingdom
items.detail: Equip Camera from Pip-Boy and take a picture at the location

items.title: Collect Energy Ammo
items.detail: Take from stash, craft at Tinker's Workbench, or loot from enemies with energy weapons

items.title: Collect a Board Game
items.detail: Take from a Games Cupboard at your C.A.M.P. if you have one placed

items.title: Destroy Robots with an Energy Weapon
items.detail: Use laser rifles, plasma guns, or tesla rifles at RobCo Research Center

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: Fast travel to RobCo Research Center for dependable robot spawns

items.title: Harvest a Wild Plant or Fungi
items.detail: Harvest from the wild or plant vegetables at your C.A.M.P.

items.title: Kill The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
items.detail: Appears as uninvited guest at Head Hunt event during Slasher seasonal event final stage

items.title: Sell Pumpkin Pie to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Buy from Mr Waiter/Ms Waitress at Whitespring or find at Pumpkin House, then sell to vendor

items.title: Sell a Weapon to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Sell any weapon or craft inexpensive grenades to sell

items.title: Visit another Player's Shelter
items.detail: Fast travel to another player's C.A.M.P. and enter their Shelter

events.name: Minerva's Big Sale (List 8)
events.description: Minerva offers discounted plans and weapons for gold.

events.description: Earn double gold in Daily Ops with double mutation effects on public events.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: Public events spawn with mutation effects and offer special mutated loot packages.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Earn double XP from all activities including events, quests, and kills.

events.name: World Pets Update (Patch 72) - Season 27
events.description: New update introduces World Pets feature and begins Season 27 "You're S.P.E.C.I.A.L.".

events.name: Treasure Hunter and Double Mutations
events.description: Treasure Hunter event with rare rewards combined with double mutation effects.

events.name: Holiday Scorched
events.description: Holiday-themed scorched creatures spawn with festive rewards and gift farming opportunities.
